audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted itself and the packet: phases said Mel/Skill/Yone/Yone/Mel/Yone/Yone while the packet chart and every whys[] line said Skill/Skill/Skill/Yone/Yone/Yone/Yone. whys[4] said 'Level 6 favours you' while win[4] and phases[4].side both said Mel.
audit.why: Yone is 56.1% over 2139 games and whys[0-2] already describe levels 1-3 as even; Mel has no escape and Fate Sealed is a hard commit onto a 250-range self-barrier champion, so level 6 is Yone's row.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-3 = Skill, rows 4-5 onward = Yone, matching the packet chart and the existing whys text. Proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Spike structure is right: Yone at Q3/levels 4-5, level 6 Fate Sealed, Blade of the Ruined King first item, 2-item side lane. Mel's spikes are Solar Snare rank-ups (11 -> 9s) and level 6 Golden Eclipse.
audit.corrected: Kept the four spikes; corrected the ability slots inside spikes[0] and spikes[1] and added Solar Snare's real 9-11s cooldown so the spike text is actionable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Solar Snare was repeatedly called 'her R'. Solar Snare is Mel's E; her R is Golden Eclipse. Rebuttal (W) was described as reflecting 'your abilities and CC back at you' — per Riot's text it reflects projectiles, prevents her taking damage and grants move speed, and Yone's kit carries no projectile flags. Fate Sealed was called a knockup that 'sets up team knockups nothing can dodge' — it is a blink behind the last champion in a line plus a pull; the knockup belongs to the third Mortal Steel cast. Yone was also given a 'second Q dash charge' at level 4, which does not exist.
audit.why: Riot ability text and the kit slots in the brief; the mirror audit (mel__yone) already recorded the same Fate Sealed correction and the reflect-to-immunity rewrite, so both sides now state it identically.
audit.corrected: Solar Snare named as (E) with its 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 cooldown, Golden Eclipse named as the global R that fires off Overwhelm stacks, Rebuttal restated as a 38s damage-immunity window to bait, Fate Sealed restated as blink-behind-and-pull, and the dash restated as the Q3 Mortal Steel cast. Added the missing Searing Brilliance (P) execute threshold.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere warned that Searing Brilliance (P) executes off accumulated Overwhelm stacks.
audit.why: The passive stacks infinitely and consumes the stacks to execute, so the kill threshold is not where the health bar suggests.
audit.corrected: Added to report[5].t: watch the HP number, not the bar.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mel's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind her and pulls her in — that is your all-in. Golden Eclipse (R) hits you anywhere off Overwhelm stacks.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge — build your teamfight around that. Mel carry threat: 8/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind her back line and pulls them to you — build your teamfight around that. Mel carry threat: 8/10 — shift to picks and wave control if she gets ahead.

edits.before: Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Solar Snare (E) roots at its centre on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 — dodge it, then engage in that window.

edits.before: Track Mel's Solar Snare: Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. When it is down — Q3 + E burst, snap back safe.
edits.after: Track Solar Snare (E) — dodge the root, then Q3 + E burst. Searing Brilliance (P) executes off Overwhelm stacks: watch the number.

edits.before: Mel pokes with Radiant Volley (Q) and her Rebuttal (W) can reflect your abilities, so time your engages when her W is down; by 4-5 your Q3 dash out-ranges her stationary casting.
edits.after: Mel pokes with Radiant Volley (Q) and Rebuttal (W) blocks all damage for its window on a 38s cooldown, so commit after it drops; by 4-5 your Q3 dash beats her stationary casting.

edits.before: Her R Solar Snare is a threat, but your E Soul Unbound and R Fate Sealed let you close and burst her squishy mage frame before she chains you.
edits.after: Solar Snare (E) roots every 9-11s, but Soul Unbound (E) and Fate Sealed (R) let you close and burst her squishy mage frame before she chains you.

edits.before: Land R Solar Snare to root and kite you
edits.after: Land Solar Snare (E) to root and kite you

edits.before: The opening is skill-based: Mel pokes with Radiant Volley (Q) from range, and her Rebuttal (W) can reflect your abilities and CC back at you, so a mistimed engage punishes you. But she casts stationary and has no escape, so bait the W out, then walk up when her Q is on cooldown. Levels 1-3 come down to whether you respect her reflect window.
edits.after: The opening is skill-based: Mel pokes with Radiant Volley (Q) from range, and Rebuttal (W) blocks all damage for its window and speeds her up, so a mistimed commit does nothing. She casts stationary and has no escape, so bait the 38s W, then walk up while her Q is down. Levels 1-3 come down to whether you respect that window.

edits.before: From level 4 the lane tilts to you: your second Q dash charge and W Spirit Cleave let you close the gap faster than she can kite, and every Radiant Volley you sidestep is a free trade. At 6 respect her R Solar Snare, but your E Soul Unbound and R Fate Sealed let you dive onto her squishy frame and burst her before she chains the root.
edits.after: From level 4 the lane tilts to you: the Q3 Mortal Steel dash and Spirit Cleave (W) close the gap faster than she can kite, and every Radiant Volley you sidestep is a free trade. At 6 respect Solar Snare (E), her 9-11s root, but Soul Unbound (E) and Fate Sealed (R) let you dive her squishy frame and burst her before she chains it.

notes: Mel's R is Golden Eclipse (global, scales off Overwhelm stacks), not Solar Snare — the file had the slot wrong in four places. Rebuttal is damage immunity plus a projectile reflect; Yone's kit carries no projectile flags in the data, so the old 'reflects your abilities and CC' line was wrong in both halves. Level chart aligned to the packet and to the existing whys text.
